name: Luxin Venture Capital Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Luxin Venture Capital Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Luxin Investment Holdings Group Co.,Ltd. It is a private equity and venture capital firm specializes in start-ups, growth capital, emerging industries, expansion stage, mature stage and pre-IPOs. For growth capital and emerging industries, the firm invests in companies with a potential for Small and Medium Enterprise board listing, with a minimum sales revenue of RMB 100 million (USD 15.72 million) for the past year, and with a minimum net profit of RMB 10 million (USD 1.57 million).
